predicate.label: publisher of publication
predicate.definition: Person or organization X holds or held the publisher role for publication Y, or explicitly publishes Y.
includes: explicit publication of the identified newspaper, journal, book, or other work
excludes: editor, writer, owner, developer, or director alone
travel to a publisher or publication office
a work merely mentioning or reviewing Y
predicate.notes: Publisher is distinct from editor and from ownership. Co-occurring ownership does not replace the requirement for publication or an explicit publisher role.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit publisher-of title; explicit publication of the identified newspaper, journal, book, or other work; historical publisher role. Excludes: editor, writer, owner, developer, or director alone; travel to a publisher or publication office; a work merely mentioning or reviewing Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: incomplete publication title; unclear publisher-versus-author or title attachment. Publisher is distinct from editor and from ownership. Co-occurring ownership does not replace the requirement for publication or an explicit publisher role.

rationale: Omitted-object send-to is frequent but does not identify a transfer meaning. Explicit publisher/publish supplies the unique specific publishing-office family; editor/founder/writer rows are distinct. Weak minority signal retained.
